name: Juno Iacocca
source:
"I'm sure you and I are totally different types of people... that's why I also looking forward to talk about a lot of things with you."

An influencer who enjoys doing make up and fashion.
Has a soft, gender-neutral atmosphere, but does stunts for a living.  
He is popular for doing things at his own pace, his humbleness, and his natural style.
